identity_required: responsible lawyer and Florida Bar profile or qualifying-provider authority

exclude: free-text case narrative in initial form
required_controls: server-side schema validation and body byte limit
fixed exact origin allowlist with CSRF protections
durable tenant and advertiser binding resolved server-side
idempotency key and unique durable persistence
immutable consent text version and timestamp
no personal data in logs, analytics or URLs
required_live_tests: synthetic lead accepted once and read back by correct tenant
duplicate request does not create another lead
upstream failure returns failure with no false success
contact routing delivered to verified recipient without real outreach

production: one canonical brand domain with verified ownership
unique useful practice and resource pages
absolute canonicals and XML sitemap from approved route inventory
LegalService and attorney schema only for verified facts
visible source citations and named legal reviewer
FAQ answers visible in page; no rich-result guarantee
descriptive links and clean topic hubs
robots indexing change only at approved release

release.rollback: retain previous immutable deployment; rehearse on approved canary before promotion

rollout.domains: distinct legitimate brands/audiences only; no city doorway clones
